name: SEC-EDGAR-python-scraper
what_it_holds: Scraper/parser (24 stars, updated 3 Sep 2026) extracting fundamental financial data (income statement / balance sheet line items) for US companies from EDGAR filings.
why_useful: Lightweight alternative for pulling peer (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) fundamentals if edgartools proves too heavy; minor incremental value only.
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Lightweight alternative for pulling peer (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) fundamentals if edgartools proves too heavy; minor incremental value only.

name: ETL-10-K-Filings
what_it_holds: Python ETL pipeline (17 stars, updated 10 May 2026) focused on the MD&A section of 10-K filings, processing data for 10,000+ publicly traded companies with multi-threaded parsing.
why_useful: Could generate an MD&A text corpus across all SEC filers (not just ABNB peers) for cross-sectional management-tone or topic-model comparisons at scale; overlaps somewhat with edgar-crawler.
time_coverage: not stated, likely recent filings only
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Could generate an MD&A text corpus across all SEC filers (not just ABNB peers) for cross-sectional management-tone or topic-model comparisons at scale; overlaps somewhat with edgar-crawler.

name: edgar (tumarkin)
what_it_holds: Command-line utility (13 stars, BSD-3, updated 9 Jan 2026) that locally indexes and downloads filings from the SEC EDGAR full-text index.
why_useful: Simple CLI for point-in-time bulk-downloading peer 8-K/10-Q filings by date, useful for building a local vintage archive of BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT prints; marginal versus edgartools/sec-edgar.
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Simple CLI for point-in-time bulk-downloading peer 8-K/10-Q filings by date, useful for building a local vintage archive of BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT prints; marginal versus edgartools/sec-edgar.

name: sec-api-io (python wrapper)
what_it_holds: Unofficial Python wrapper (6 stars, MIT, updated 3 Sep 2026) around the sec-api.io commercial service for searching/filtering SEC filings.
why_useful: Python-side counterpart to sec-api-node; same caveat that the backing service is paid beyond a free tier, so only free-tier full-text search calls are usable without a key purchase.
time_coverage: full EDGAR coverage via the paid service
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Python-side counterpart to sec-api-node; same caveat that the backing service is paid beyond a free tier, so only free-tier full-text search calls are usable without a key purchase.

name: OpenEDGAR
what_it_holds: Django-based framework that builds a local relational database from EDGAR filings, automating retrieval and parsing of EDGAR forms at scale (used to power LexPredict's commercial legal-document database). MIT, 332 stars, 99 forks, 54 commits, first released 2018.
why_useful: Heavier-weight option if the team wants a queryable local database (rather than flat files) of all peer + ABNB filings with full parsing pipeline already built, e.g. for building a structured 8-K/10-Q archive with a real ORM/schema.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps other EDGAR clients; heavier infra than needed for our team's scope
size_hint: n/a, framework only, older/less active (54 commits, oldest activity 2018)
